reviews.comment: This was one of the most easiest and fun classes I've taken so far! There are no quizzes or exams; rather, the class is based entirely on projects with a few discussion posts sprinkled in, alongside extra credit. There are some group projects, which is the only difficult part. But other than that, it's super fun and manageable! :)

This was honestly one of the easiest and most fun classes I've taken so far! There are no tests or quizzes, and you don't even have to watch the online lectures. It's all project based with a few discussion posts sprinkled in. Honestly, the only hard is just dealing with group mates for some of the projects. But they were all fun to do! :)
lots of group projects but the experience will depend on who your group members are. No feedback on assignments. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. no tests or quizzes. Overall easy course.

Very easy and manageable class with clear expectations. No tests or quizzes, just group projects and discussions, and the workload was light. Only downside is that your experience can depend on your group. Overall, I'd recommend.

Mr. B is possibly the most chill professor ever, I'd recommend taking him in person, online makes you pay more. After the first few weeks, no one even goes to his class, so he gives extra credit to people who do come. He knows his stuff, and the work isn't hard at all!

The Ends class was easy. Attendance was not mandatory but he gave extra credit to people who did come. He is awesome and likes what he teaches. The work isn't hard, its group projects and discussion posts.

The online version is the easiest creative art ever. The only annoying thing is group projects (which are easy), but just weird since it's an online class. The individual assignments are also easy. He responded quickly when I had any questions, which was rare. HIGHLY recommend, so chill.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A and GPA booster. Going to lecture seriously is unnecessary. I went to class probably only once a week and if I did go to class I did other work. Mr.B gives plenty of extra credit opportunities and as long as you don't wait till the last minute to do the assignments you'll be fine
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class. I stopped attending lectures after the 3rd week since they have nothing to do with the projects. There are a couple group projects but as long as your group is decent you will be fine. I recommend for an easy A, but you won't learn anything. There are no exams.

Mr. B is nice, but lectures have nothing to do with assignments. I did homework for other classes during this class and was able to complete projects easily. No exams. He is friendly and helpful if you have questions, I just found the class extremely boring. It's not hard though, as long as you don't wait until the last minute to start projects.

Fairly simple class. 2 individual, 3 group assignments, and 4 discussion posts. No exams or quizzes. You really just need to maintain good contact with your group members, and the rest is a breeze since you can start those assignments the week they're due.

2 individual projects and 3 group projects, thats pretty much it. The easiest class I took this semester which I appreciated because it was 18 credit hours! Seems like a nice guy, similar to other reviews you can just neglect the class until there is a project which is like once a month until the end when there is like 3 within 2 weeks!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Took for my creative art credit and don't regret it! 2 individual projects and 3 group ones. Multiple video lectures each week but you don't have to watch them to do well in the class. I would completely neglect this class until there was a project due and still made As on all the projects. Super easy credit and kind of fun! Definitely recommend!

Very easy A, but relies on group work, so you have to get lucky with the group. The hardest part is remembering to do assignments; there's no need to read or watch lectures. Easiest A in my life. If you want an easy take it.

Super great class, as long as you complete the big projects and have a good group (for group projects), this course should be a breeze. I also really enjoyed the content of this class. Stay on top of your projects because they can be time-consuming!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ENDS 101 was an easy A. Quite honestly, the lectures aren't necessary, but it's clear he cares about the class and content and is a good prof. I do wish I had taken a different class for credit, but if you need an easy A you should take it.

One of the easier GPA boosts at tamu. I think there abt one assignment every two weeks and maybe took an hour out of my day. I got 100s on almost everything and the group assignments are super easy def take him and this class.

The class is an easy Creative Arts. Only hard thing is planning times to meet up with groups for an ongoing group project, but the material isn't difficult in the slightest. There are a few individual projects, discussion posts, and the ongoing group project but once again not hard at all. Clear expectations in the syllabus.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: If you want a good GPA booster class this is the class for you. Super easy class. There's one ongoing group project so make sure to be on top of that. Assignments were pretty straightforward. Definitely recommend this class!

Liked this class a lot. Good/interesting content. Easy A. Good GPA booster while still being fun. prof is SO super nice. Encourages participation, I definitely think he enjoys when students are involved. EC opportunities for attendance in class among many other things. HIGHLY recommended

This class allows you to put your creativity , innovation and imagination to the test. Its a pretty simple and clear class, the prof is filled with passion and he is very chill and dosent ask for much, there is a few projects but not too bad. Prof is basic and class is fun!

I liked Professor Billingsley. Lectures weren't always the most interesting or concrete, but he is a good speaker and presenter that knows his slides inside and out. Assignments were fairly easy, but make sure to take advantage of extra credit to ensure a good grade. In other words, show up to class, cause that's where most of the EC comes from.
Literally so chill and one discussion a week with a couple of assignments. I loved this class and recommend it to everyone!!

It was a low-maintenance and interesting class. The assignments were odd, but they definitely taught me to get creative and design something unique. Definitely a great way to knock out your art credit!

Was super easy, just have to do the few assignments that really just felt like busy work or something you'd do in high school. He posted lecture videos but I never really watched them and I passed with flying colors. Simple material and a few group projects but really simple once you do your part. Only really gave it my attention the day it was due

Took 101 for my creative arts, and it was super easy. Very few assignments overall and a few group assignments that were quick and easy. Just have to do the work and it's a guaranteed good grade. Was a class that I didn't have to worry about. No exams or quizzes and he offered extra credit at the end of the semester. Didn't have to pay for anything

There is absolutely no need to attend lecture as it does not pertain to any assignments given. The entire class is mostly a bunch of group projects that take only a couple of hours at most to complete. Sometimes he is tough with grading as an A is "only reserved for the best of the best", but he offers so much extra credit throughout the course.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall the class was not the most entertaining but it is a decent creative arts class to take if you need a relatively easy A. He offers a lot of extra credit opportunities and most of your grades will be group and individual projects which are not too difficult. Just make sure to actually put effort into your assignments.

Billingsley is awesome. ENDS101 is so easy with him, just do your portion of the group projects and you'll pass with an A. I never had any questions about anything regarding content or expectations. Try not to procrastinate but I did and did amazing so who really cares. There are online lectures, I didn't watch a single one and did great.
A lot of this online course was busy work it seemed. There were tons of group projects but nothing hard. No exams, super cool guy. Easy arts credit!

I don't remember much about this class, but I do remember it being extremely easy. This is a great class to take if you need to fill some hours or requirements. Don't remember there being too much work. Don't skip class, when I took it I remember attendance being pretty important.
This is the easiest course I have ever taken. There were only 5 or 6 assignments and they are all grades so easily. If you put in the smallest amount of effort you will get an A.
Easiest A I have ever done and I still have no clue what I was supposed to learn in this class. Take ENDS 101 as a GPA booster, hours filler, or to just get a requirement out of the way.

If you are looking for an easy A this class is it, Mr. B is definitely caring and passionate with his lectures which were interesting. I didn't go to class and still received an A. There are major group projects but if you email him with problems he fixes it. Mine was in person although they offer online as well so I am not sure how online is.

Dr. Billingsley loves his job. He's very passionate about the course, but overall, it's INSANELY easy. I got A's on all the projects, everything is literally just simple work that you'd do in an 8th grade class. Lectures are virtually pointless, just 150 slides about being inspired and loving innovation, so if you need an easy art credit, take it.

Real easy class, but both a rude and bad prof. I sent two emails asking questions and in both he responded in a rude way. He doesn't give any feedback and sometimes his grading criteria is unclear. As long as you get a decent group though its a real easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the easiest class ever. No tests, quizzes, or assignments- just individual and group projects. I made a 100 on every single project and I did them the day they were due, not sure why everyone else is complaining. Just follow his directions carefully and you'll be completely fine. Never went to lectures either, made a 100 in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do the extra credit if you like, it improves your grade by 1% for each extra credit HW done. Does not have any feedback for HW.

Easy course, just follow all of the instructions to a T. He is super picky about every little thing, even how files were named. Willing to accommodate if you have extenuating circumstances. No exams, just busy work and group projects. Real easy A, but a useless course.

Prof Billingsley is a good guy and pretty chill. ~88% of grade will come from 2 individual projects and 3 team projects. As long as you follow the rubric and instructions you should be fine. The hardest part of this class was just planning with team members. Overall it's a pretty easy course and if you just follow instructions you should make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he is a fine prof. however this class is one of the worst i've ever taken. if you don't like group projects, stay away from this class. there are 4 individual projects and 4 group projects for the whole semester. one of the projects involved 'making a superhero team'. it is very easy, but is annoying to do.

This online class was super easy. Majority group work, but not hard to complete if you collaborate in advance. Overall hardly any work to complete. My one complaint is it takes a LONG time for work to be graded, but he seems to grade easy for the admittedly low effort I have put in. Take him for low effort/easy A!

His lectures are mostly comprised of reading off presentation slides. He tries to make the lectures fun, but it's clear the group projects are the main focus. Your grade is based off 4 major projects (2 of them are group projects), as well as 2 small posts on Canvas. The projects are a lot of fun if you get a good group.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Billingsley is simply an OK teacher. Prerecorded lectures are lengthy and not necessary to complete the course. Not much to learn in this class, just do the projects. There are extra credit opportunities. A manageable A if you put a little effort.

Professor Billingsley gives you all the tools you need to succeed in his class. Lots of group work for an online course but ended up working out well. VERY wordy assignments but once you read them it makes sense.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is very short when it comes to directions and when you email him about it, he still does not explain what you were asking. This class is pretty much based on group projects that you were assigned to, and you just have to hope you get a good group. He is a very hard grader.

This guy is terrible. My friend was in hospital and asked he asked for a 24 hour extension on an assignment and Billingsley refused. Additionally if you get a bad group in this class your grade is going to suffer. Assignments are graded extremely harsh while also feeling like you are in middle school. Would not recommend
Lots of group projects graded based on creativity. Great professor!

Easy class, just have to turn in quality work. Grade is based on a few projects (half individual and half group). Turned in a mediocre Personal Branding Profile and got a 90 , tried harder after that and got 100 on everything else. You could make the goofiest project and still get a 100 if it shows you put in quality time and effort to make it.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took his ENDS 101 class and all I say is DO NOT TAKE this class. I took it for the creative arts credit and there are so many other classes you can take for the credit that are 100 times easier. All this class consists of is group projects and he will give you an awful grade and not even tell you why.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Be prepared to have to make a lot of presentations.. I made a excellent personal branding profile that met all of the rubrics requirements and still made an 85 on it. Overall though if youre good at working with groups and have a creative mindset you should do good in this class. Also this class isnt that big of a blowoff so be ready.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Thought this was supposed to be an easy A, it wasn't. Didn't know what was going on the entire time. Lectures were not useful at all and were useless. Grade is mostly based off group projects and he's a tough grader. Do the extra credit. It will literally bump you up a letter grade if you do all of them.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is supposedly the easiest class to get an A in at A&M... but your grade essentially comes down to a few group projects and an individual project. The grading was unclear and class averages were consistently in the low 70s for each. There is extra credit, so I would recommend doing all of it because you'll need the points.

Class was loaded with political info. You'd think it was a POLS class. Lectures were outdated TED talks on unrelated topics & the final assignment was so political, I'm concerned I might not get a good grade on it. If you need a GPA booster, this is probably it. But be prepared for extremely wordy & complicated group projects.

Pushes an agenda nonsensically for your final individual project. The course is entirely made up of group projects and watching videos from seminars the prof had nothing to do with. I learned nothing from this class and regret ever wasting my time or money on it
Pushes his own leftist Politcal agenda and if you do not alter your opinion you will NOT earn full credit. Workload fair.
Pushes own agenda for no reason. Not clear grading criteria. But minimal effort required to pass the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I absolutely cannot explain how much I hated this prof. It was a 101 class I took for a creative arts I think ? and the amount of work he assigned was absurd!! In addition, you have FIVE group projects so if you're stuck in a crappy group like I was, get ready to do all the work! He is annoying and the class is boring, I hated it sm. Easy B.

Your grade ENTIRELY depends on your group. Literally half of the rubric is dependent on others turning in the project correctly. The projects are relatively easy, but you receive no feedback on your grade (unless you specifically ask), so you can lose the same points each time. You can do quite lots of extra credit to try and get a decent grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Thought it would be a fairly easy online class... and as a senior this class is an absolute waste of time. The assignments are crazy long and are self reflective . The group project was bs and the weekly powerpoints had anywhere from 50-200+ slides. Don't take this class.
Better than his co-instructor, Dr. Vanegas. However, that isn't saying much. At least Andrew would try to engage with students more and teach the concepts in a more relatable manner.
So much work, busy work on top of that. Every submission is a completion grade but each homework serves no purpose. Do the online class. Not worth the time.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: At the end of each week you have a 5 question opinionated quiz that you literally cannot get less than an A on. 4 group projects. Never quizzed or tested on the material. I went to class only two times -- the first day of school and to meet with my group. The group projects are pointless and just busy work but the easiest class I have ever taken.

I honestly can't even fairly rate Billingsley because this class was so stupid. Want an easy B? Waste some time here. Want an A that you have no idea how to get? Attempt it here. Never have to show up to class, group projects are never a good thing, and his instructions for everything are way too wordy. Okay instructor, horrible class.
